kbArticles.title: SOP-SEC-01: Cyber Incident Response & SWIFT Triage Procedure
kbArticles.summary: Mandatory escalation, containment, and notification steps for unauthorized access against SWIFT Alliance Gateway.
kbArticles.contentMarkdown:
# SOP-SEC-01: Cyber Incident Response & SWIFT Triage Procedure

## 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) defines the mandatory escalation, containment, and notification steps required when an unauthorized access or brute-force event is detected against Apex Bank's SWIFT Alliance Gateway.

## 2. Emergency Escalation Matrix
1. **SOC Level-1 Analyst**: Identify and classify incident severity within 15 minutes.
2. **SOC Lead**: Engage on-call incident response team and implement perimeter rate-limiting.
3. **CISO**: Provide dual-control executive sign-off for firewall policy modifications.

## 3. Regulatory Incident Notification (Central Bank)
All Tier-1 payment infrastructure breaches exceeding 60 minutes of containment threshold must be reported to the Central Bank Cyber Security Department within 2 hours.

kbArticles.title: SOP-SEC-02: Dual-Control Security Policy Exception Lifecycle
kbArticles.summary: Under ISO 27001 & Central Bank regulations, no single individual may grant a production firewall or cryptographic policy exception.
kbArticles.contentMarkdown:
# SOP-SEC-02: Dual-Control Security Policy Exception Lifecycle

## 1. 4-Eyes Principle Authorization
Under ISO 27001 & Central Bank regulations, no single individual may grant a production firewall or cryptographic policy exception.

## 2. Multi-Stage Approval Workflow
- Step 1: Technical Review by SOC Operations Lead.
- Step 2: Risk Evaluation & Sign-off by CISO.
- Maximum exception validity is 30 calendar days.
